rationale: Price has already sold off sharply from the open high of $235.94 down to $231.14, sitting at only 29.8% of today's range and well below both the session VWAP ($232.84) and the 9-EMA ($234.23), indicating the gap-up momentum has reversed. The wide bid-ask spread of 61.9 bps on a stock with a $1.00 ATR creates an unfavorable entry cost, and with the broader market under pressure (SPY -0.95%, VIXY +2.06%), the risk/reward for either direction is unclear — a short risks a bounce from the morning low while a long faces overhead resistance at VWAP and EMA. Skipping until price stabilizes and shows a cleaner directional signal is the prudent choice.
